_meta.description: The processed-evidence streams: the built-in logs-*-* composition (logsdb, ECS dynamic mappings, the operator's logs@custom extension point) plus the decomposed logs-dxdfir@* models — logs-dxdfir@settings (the router default_pipeline and stack-wide backstops) and one model per lane (@winlog shared, @windowlicker, @log2timeline, @daemonhunter, @zeek, @detections, @hayabusa). Each lane owns its own fields; the components all merge into every logs-dxdfir.* index (unused fields for a given stream simply never populate). The failure store (rejected evidence rows) is kept a year instead of the cluster default's 30 days — a rejected row is evidence waiting for a mapping fix and a re-ingest
